node.statement: Four-corner reconstruction is invertible. At level one define beta:A->direct_sum_{j,k}S_{P_j,P_k} by beta(Z)=(Co_{P_j,P_k}Z) and alpha by summation. Put s=P_1+P_2=I+r, ||r||<=t. By the compression estimate in def-compressed-corner, alpha beta(Z) differs from sum_{j,k}P_j(ZP_k)=s(Zs) by at most K_c*t||Z||. Bilinearity with the displayed parentheses gives the exact expansion s(Zs)=I(ZI)+I(Zr)+r(ZI)+r(Zr). The approximate-unit and product axioms, ||r||<=t, and t<=1 show ||s(Zs)-Z||<=K_s*t||Z||. Hence ||alpha beta-I_A||<=K_rec*t. Choosing t<1/(2K_rec), the Neumann series makes alpha beta invertible, so alpha is surjective.
